The decisive mistake was at step 0. ISBNCheckDigit_Expert asserted the Tropicos ID for Helotiales as 8200000 without retrieving it, so the ID was unverified and every later calculation used it. The ID I would expect for Helotiales is 100370, which is from memory and not checked here.

The step 0 code also computed the ISBN-10 check digit incorrectly. It used positions 1 to 9 over a zero-padded ID and took the sum modulo 11, which does not match the standard method. Later agents never questioned either problem, and they spent the remaining steps on code that kept printing X.

AGENT: ISBNCheckDigit_Expert
STEP: 0
